name: Spam Image Cleaner Scanner
description: Scans manga folders for promotional watermarks and ad pages using trained weights.

volumes.name: scanDir
volumes.description: Directory of manga images to scan and clean

parameters.name: --threshold
parameters.label: Spam Threshold
parameters.description: Confidence threshold to classify image as spam (0.0 - 1.0)

parameters.name: --move_spam
parameters.label: Move Spam to Subfolder
parameters.description: Move flagged spam images into a 'spam_detected/' subfolder

parameters.name: --rename_spam
parameters.label: Rename Spam in Place
parameters.description: Append '-spam' suffix to flagged image filenames
